meta_description: Chief Delivery Officer at Achala IT Solutions — Runs the global delivery centers in Hyderabad, Munich and Sofia and the first-90-days engagement machinery.

blocks.x: Chief Delivery Officer at Achala IT Solutions, the mandate, the standards this office enforces, and how clients engage with it directly.
This role exists to keep the delivery engine honest: scope that ships, metrics that reconcile, and a floor of engineering standards no schedule pressure can breach.
How this office works with clients
Client time concentrates where risk lives, baseline sign-off, gate reviews and incident follow-ups, with the delivery pod carrying the weekly rhythm under the leader's standards.
The operating principle is simple, the leader owns the standards, the practice leads own the books, and every program publishes evidence either way.

items: Delivery centers is reported against the signed baseline with the evidence attached; if the number stops moving, the program says so.
The commitment on Engagement machinery is written into the engagement charter, scope, owner and the measurement method agreed before delivery begins.
We commit to Quality gates as a measured outcome, reported every fortnight, audited at the gate, owned by a name on both sides.

blocks.x: To bring this office into a gate review or baseline session, start from the briefing page and name the domain.
